name: VANTNRG
recent: Vantris Energy 的巴西合资公司获得 Petrobras 价值 4.1 亿美元（约 17 亿令吉）的海底服务合约。公司最新季度营收环比增长 26.9%，但净利环比下降 48.4%。此外，公司于 10 月更换了公司秘书。
notable: 巴西合资公司获得 Petrobras 价值 4.1 亿美元的海底服务合约。
公司更换公司秘书，由 CHOONG SIEW MUN 接任。
risks: 最新季度净利环比下降 48.4%，净利率从 22.6% 降至 9.2%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日季度，营收为 8.18455 亿令吉，环比增长 26.9%，同比增长 2.1%；净利为 7530.2 万令吉，环比下降 48.4%，净利率为 9.2%，低于上一季度的 22.6%。

recent_en: Vantris Energy's Brazil JV secured a USD410 million (about RM1.7 billion) subsea services contract from Petrobras. Latest quarterly revenue rose 26.9% QoQ while net income fell 48.4% QoQ. The company also changed its company secretary in October.
notable_en: Brazil JV secured a USD410 million subsea services contract from Petrobras.
The company changed its company secretary, with CHOONG SIEW MUN appointed.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net income fell 48.4% QoQ, with net margin dropping from 22.6% to 9.2%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR818.455 million, up 26.9% QoQ and 2.1% YoY; net income was MYR75.302 million, down 48.4% QoQ, with net margin at 9.2% versus 22.6% in the prior quarter.
